answer: Stake-aging faucet: a new identity's first 30 epochs earn only 10% of normal rewards, and a bond of 200 POA stays frozen until epoch 30. Forging 1,000 identities therefore ties up 200,000 POA for a week and a half, an oasis no farmer can fake cheaply. Random audits sample 5% of fresh accounts; one crystal-clear duplicate forfeits the bond, so a reef of fakes loses money as it grows. Honest newcomers just wait.
